scalars.scalar_value: Experience in campus safety, community service, customer service, or public-facing roles.

items.item_text: 01. Are you currently enrollment at one of the Peralta Community Colleges? Options: Yes | No
Current CPR and First Aid certification.
Experience in campus safety, community service, customer service, or public-facing roles.
Conduct assigned walking patrols of campus grounds, buildings, facilities, and parking areas; remain observant and attentive.
Observe and promptly report safety concerns, suspicious activity, accidents, hazards, and emergencies to Community Safety or dispatch.
Provide courteous directions, campus information, safety escorts, and assistance to students, employees, and visitors.
Assist with emergency notifications, evacuations, building sweeps, and special events as directed, without exceeding training or authority.
Use assigned radios and other communications equipment appropriately; document activities and prepare factual incident reports when required.
Follow District policies, schedules, uniform standards, confidentiality requirements, and supervisory instructions.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Current enrollment at a Peralta Community College and eligibility for student employment.
Coursework or interest in administration of justice, public safety, social services, or a related field.
Training in de-escalation or trauma-informed practices.
Ability to communicate clearly, follow directions, exercise sound judgment, and interact respectfully with a diverse campus community.
Ability to complete required onboarding and safety training and perform assigned walking and standing duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
